evidence.quote: Over three years (six semesters), you will gain in-depth knowledge of computer science
Classes are held entirely in English.
Tuition fees per semester The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
English language skills B2 required, proof via placement test/interview

note.fr: Un contrat de formation pratique avec une entreprise partenaire (Dualer Partner) doit être signé avant l'inscription ; contactez directement l'entreprise.
note.en: A training contract with a workplace training provider (Dualer Partner) must be signed before enrolment; contact the company directly.

evidence.quote: Enrollment at the university is only possible after a training contract with a workplace training provider has been signed.

note.fr: Les candidats titulaires d'un diplôme étranger doivent faire évaluer leur diplôme par le Central International Office du DHBW ; prévoyez plusieurs semaines.
note.en: Applicants with a foreign qualification must have their credentials assessed by the Central International Office of DHBW; allow several weeks.

evidence.quote: Enrolment of international degree seeking students, who received their university entrance qualification abroad, is only possible after the assessment of equivalency.
The assessment of foreign academic credentials usually takes 2 to 3 weeks and is free of charge.
